tickets.title: Cash distribution request
tickets.text: Collect the current mortgage payoff quote, full HELOC statement, and any prepayment-penalty language from Clockwork Clover Mortgage and Teacup Comet Bank to enable a complete refinance review.
tickets.evidence: Loan document collection was completed on 2024-04-09, with the current mortgage payoff quote, full HELOC statement, and any prepayment-penalty language not available during the conversation, limiting a complete refinance review.

tickets.title: Gather debt refinance review details
tickets.text: Reconcile the difference between the Thimble Harbor Credit Union phone-system payoff amount and the latest monthly statement for Julian Mossbutton’s auto loan, and determine how the discrepancy affects the debt-repayment order.
tickets.evidence: Auto loan payoff reconciliation was completed on 2024-04-09 after Julian reported one payoff amount from the Thimble Harbor Credit Union phone system that did not match the latest monthly statement, and the difference affects the debt-repayment order.

tickets.title: Complete access recovery checks
tickets.text: Restore Julian Mossbutton’s access to the Moonbadger Robotics retirement plan portal by updating the multi-factor authentication phone number from the old number to the current one, enabling review of plan loan rules and contribution settings.
tickets.evidence: Employer plan access recovery was completed on 2024-04-09 after Julian could not open the Moonbadger Robotics retirement plan portal because multi-factor authentication still used an old phone number, blocking review of plan loan rules and contribution settings.

tickets.title: Update cash-flow budget after household income change
tickets.text: Update the household’s revised cash-flow budget reflecting Lena Mossbutton’s reduced work schedule and the resulting decrease in take-home pay to about $9,250 per month, and determine the target for accelerated debt repayment.
tickets.evidence: The cash-flow update after the household income change was completed on 2024-04-09; Lena’s reduced work schedule lowered household take-home pay, and the revised budget is needed before setting a target for accelerated debt repayment.

tickets.title: Review tax-aware investment liquidation for debt reduction
tickets.text: Review the tax impact of selling appreciated holdings from the joint taxable investment account at Velvet Acorn Custody for debt reduction, before using investments as a funding source for the mortgage or HELOC reset.
tickets.evidence: tax-aware investment liquidation review was completed on 2024-04-09; a review of the taxable account showed appreciated holdings that could be sold for debt reduction, and the tax impact needs to be estimated before using investments as a funding source.

tickets.title: Coordinate tax notice follow-up
tickets.text: Coordinate with the household’s CPA to receive the debt-restructure assumptions, potential investment-sale amounts, and questions about home-equity interest treatment for the current tax year.

subTasks.title: Collect and classify the notice
subTasks.text: Request a complete copy of the notice, envelope, and any prior correspondence. Record the tax year, agency, notice type, proposed amount, and response options.

subTasks.title: Reconcile notice against planning records
subTasks.text: Compare the notice to available return summaries, estimated tax payment records, withholding information, retirement distributions, and prior client notes.

subTasks.title: Coordinate with the client’s CPA or tax preparer
subTasks.text: Send a concise summary with placeholders for the notice type, tax year, amount, and requested action. Ask the tax professional to confirm whether the client should respond, dispute, amend, or pay.

subTasks.title: Document final action and follow-up
subTasks.text: Record the agreed response plan, evidence reviewed, submission method, and any follow-up check needed after the response is sent.

tickets.evidence: CPA coordination on interest treatment and investment sales was completed on 2024-04-09 after Julian asked that the household’s CPA receive the debt-restructure assumptions, potential investment-sale amounts, and questions about home-equity interest treatment for the current tax year.
